notes_for_editor: The 1934 build and 1948 ruin date rest on one firelookout.com page. The FFLA index and the Forest Lookouts Lincoln County list confirm gone status, county and forest, not the dates. Two searches returned Kenelty Mountain and Calx Mountain, which are different lookouts, and were not used. No staffing, access or fire history found. The 32N-33W-23 location is from the county list and has not been checked against the coordinates.
